name: Behold the Face of Justice!
flavor: You attack a foe and your enemies behold a vision of the true nature of your resolve.

tiers.text: 3 + M holy damage; if the target has this potency, each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)
tiers.raw: 3 + M holy damage; if the target has P<WEAK, each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)

tiers.text: 5 + M holy damage; if the target has this potency, each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)
tiers.raw: 5 + M holy damage; if the target has P<AVERAGE, each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)

tiers.text: 8 + M holy damage; if the target has this potency, each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)
tiers.raw: 8 + M holy damage; if the target has P<STRONG, each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)

effect: Each enemy frightened this way is pushed up to 2 squares away from the target and takes psychic damage equal to your Presence score.
